_meta.title: LIRIL dev-team PASS-rate measurement — 2026-04-18
_meta.purpose: Honest before/after measurement of whether the LIRIL self-improvement loop (fallback parser + URL hallucination gate + few-shot + memory store) actually improved autonomous PASS rate.

baseline.note: After initial NATS port fix only

post_memory.state: fallback parser + URL gate + 3-role few-shot + sqlite memory store

delta.interpretation: The LIRIL-requested self-improvements (few-shot from past schema_ok transcripts, sqlite memory-backed similarity ranking, URL hallucination gate, fallback verdict parser) produced a measurable 17 percentage-point improvement in dev-team PASS rate over the fresh baseline. Not a miracle — remaining 50% UNPARSED are task-specific failures where the memory does not yet have sufficiently similar past examples. As the index grows (260 entries after this burn) coverage should improve.

next_iteration_candidates: Investigate WS-040 (P-vs-NP dashboard card) — novel task class, no close match in memory yet
Investigate WS-033/034 (vaccine-injury timeline + comparative international) — complex JSON structure, 1500-char guidance may be too tight
Measure the auto-reset daemon loop once it's been running for 2 hours (sufficient needs_rework cooldown window)
